browser.explanation: Latest result per named scenario across the initial suite and targeted corrections. Initial run 14/18; four corrections passed. Expanded suite 8/9; corrected cover fixture then passed. This is not a single clean combined run.

cases.name: dives into a live, non-blank scene with the HUD attached
W moves the octopus: the frame changes and the loop is running
the canvas follows its container when the container resizes
the HUD reports a real reef depth and pressure on arrival
descending warns about pressure before it starts doing damage
jetting burns calories faster than crawling, and says so
inking reports what ink actually does
camouflage fades when the animal leaves the bottom
a lost context during the hunt raises Retry, and Retry dives again
pause freezes dive time and energy; losing canvas focus releases held movement
the seabed is solid and the home den only protects at its actual height
target selection never catches a different nearby animal, and repeated catches persist
reef mission requires both foods and a return home, then writes one debrief
vampire squid gathers marine snow and has no ink
touch buttons move and release cleanly; settings can be changed during a dive
new rigs have distinct anatomy, render without shader errors and release every context
voluntary surfacing persists results and releases the actual WebGL context
rock cover blocks awareness and a spatial ink cloud interrupts pursuit

limitations: Real Chromium WebGL in local harness; no deployed app or classroom hardware benchmark.
Controlled-object fixtures establish rule consistency, not natural encounter balance.
